caption: Villa Lante, Bagnaia
composition: Renaissance garden with twin casini, terraces and central water chain · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the twin casini of Villa Lante across the parterre, their pale stone facades standing left and right of the central water chain. Fountains and stepped cascades run down the middle through clipped boxwood parterres, with the terraced grotto and wooded hill rising behind. The 12:40 sun is high and bright under a clear blue sky, sharpening the geometry of the hedges and stonework.
